Yaqeenan insaan par ek aisa waqt bhi aaya hai ke jab woh koi qaabil-e-zikr shai nahin tha
Yaqeenan hum ne insaan ko ek mile-jule nutfe se paida kiya hai taake is ka imtihaan lein, aur phir use samaa'at aur basaarat waala bana diya hai
Yaqeenan hum ne use raaste ki hidaayat de di hai, chaahe woh shukr-guzaar ho jaaye ya kufraan-e-ne'mat karne waala ho jaaye
Be-shak hum ne kaafireen ke liye zanjeerein, tauq aur bhadakte hue sholon ka intizaam kiya hai
Be-shak hamaare nek bande us pyaale se piyenge jis mein sharaab ke saath kaafoor ki aamezish hogi
Ye ek chashma hai jis se Allah ke nek bande piyenge aur jidhar chaahenge baha kar le jaayenge
Ye bande nazr ko poora karte hain aur us din se darte hain jis ki sakhti har taraf phaili hui hai
Ye us ki mohabbat mein miskeen, yateem aur aseer ko khaana khilaate hain
Hum sirf Allah ki marzi ki khaatir tumhein khilaate hain, warna na tum se koi badla chaahte hain na shukriya
Hum apne Parwardigar se us din ke baare mein darte hain jis din chehre bigad jaayenge aur un par hawaaiyaan udne lagengi
To Khuda ne unhein us din ki sakhti se bacha liya aur taazgi aur suroor ata kar diya
Aur unhein un ke sabr ke iwaz jannat aur hareer-e-jannat ata karega
Jahaan woh takhton par takiya lagaaye baithe honge, na aaftaab ki garmi dekhenge aur na sardi
Un ke saron par qareeb-tareen saaya hoga aur mewe bilkul un ke ikhtiyaar mein kar diye jaayenge
Un ke gird chaandi ke pyaale aur sheeshe ke saaghron ki gardish hogi
Ye saaghar bhi chaandi hi ke honge jinhein ye log apne paimaane ke mutaabiq bana lenge
Ye wahaan aise pyaale se seraab kiye jaayenge jis mein zanjabeel ki aamezish hogi
Jo jannat ka ek chashma hai jise Salsabeel kaha jaata hai
Aur un ke gird hamesha naujawaan rehne waale bachche gardish kar rahe honge, ke tum unhein dekhoge to bikhre hue moti maaloom honge
Aur phir dobaara dekhoge to ne'matein aur ek mulk-e-kabeer nazar aaega
Un ke oopar kareeb ke sabz libaas aur resham ke hulle honge, aur unhein chaandi ke kangan pehnaaye jaayenge, aur unhein un ka Parwardigar paakeeza sharaab se seraab karega
Ye sab tumhaari jaza hai aur tumhaari sa'i qaabil-e-qubool hai
Hum ne aap par Qur'an tadreejan naazil kiya hai
Lehaaza aap hukm-e-Khuda ki khaatir sabr karein aur kisi gunaahgaar ya kaafir ki baat mein na aa jaayen
Aur subah o shaam apne Parwardigar ke naam ki tasbeeh karte rahein
Aur raat ke ek hisse mein us ka sajda karein aur badi raat tak us ki tasbeeh karte rahein
Ye log sirf duniya ki ne'maton ko pasand karte hain aur apne peechhe ek bade sangeen din ko chhode hue hain
Hum ne un ko paida kiya hai aur un ke aaza ko mazboot banaaya hai, aur jab chaahenge to unhein badal kar un ke jaise doosre afraad le aayenge
Ye ek naseehat ka saamaan hai, ab jis ka jee chaahe apne Parwardigar ke raaste ko ikhtiyaar kar le
Aur tum log to sirf wahi chaahte ho jo Parwardigar chaahta hai. Be-shak Allah har cheez ka jaanne waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai
Woh jise chaahta hai apni rehmat mein daakhil kar leta hai, aur us ne zaalimeen ke liye dardnaak azaab muhayya kar rakha hai
